reports.title: Versant Media Reports Third Quarter 2026 Operating and Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: Based on year-to-date performance and expectations for the remainder of the year, the Company reaffirms its full-year 2026 outlook for revenue and Adjusted EBITDA, and now anticipates Free Cash Flow to exceed our prior forecast:
•Total Revenue: Reaffirmed outlook of $6.2 billion to $6.45 billion
•Adjusted EBITDA2: Reaffirmed outlook of $1.90 billion to $2.05 billion
•Free Cash Flow2: Expected to exceed the prior $1.0 billion to $1.2 billion range
